svg.title: Reaction time across batches
svg.desc: Synthetic manufacturing demonstration, 800 batches. The purple line is the trailing 40-batch rolling average. A dashed vertical marker is placed at batch 500, where drift was deliberately injected into the generator.
svg.text: Synthetic manufacturing data, 800 batches · generated scenario, not factory observations
Reaction time (synthetic scale) · batches 1–500 mean 59.86; 501–800 mean 62.69
